name: Pobeg v Moskvu 2
source:
The game takes place in modern Russia, some time after the events of the bad ending of the first part. The main character will try to correct his mistakes and again rushes to meet adventures!

In this game, you will have to help your friend Aliya escape from home again. During the game, you will need to make choices that will affect the plot. An exciting journey awaits you in Moscow and beyond. 

[From  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3821160/Pobeg_v_Moskvu_2/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
游戏发生在现代俄罗斯，第一部分的糟糕结局事件发生后一段时间。主角将努力改正自己的错误，再次奔赴冒险！

在这个游戏中，你将不得不帮助你的朋友阿利亚再次逃出家门。在游戏过程中，你需要做出会影响剧情的选择。莫斯科及其他地区的激动人心的旅程等待着你。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3821160/Pobeg_v_Moskvu_2/]Steam[/url]]
